Know who owns the information.

Open Path helps make a complicated journey easier to follow. The Australian Government owns its visa rules. We link to the official source, explain what to check, and show when we last reviewed our visa guidance.

Official source ownerThe Australian Government Department of Home Affairs publishes the visa requirements and application instructions.
Open Path's roleWe write the plain-language orientation, order the questions, and share lived experience. We do not decide eligibility or provide migration advice.
What the date meansThe date below is when we opened the listed official pages and reviewed the related Open Path notes. It is not the date the government changed a rule.
Link checksWe automatically check these links weekly. That confirms whether a page responds, not whether its content or our guidance has changed.

Check again before acting.

Visa pages can change between reviews. The weekly check only looks for links that stop responding. It does not detect rule or content changes, so check the official page for the latest instructions and your exact circumstances. If you need help with an individual visa matter, see who is legally able to provide immigration assistance.
